zh.summary: 0.6.0 新增 Windows 任务通知和内核版本选择，并改进插件更新与工作区打开体验。
highlights: Windows 后台任务完成或需要回答、批准时会进入系统通知中心，支持回复原任务、处理简单选项和任务栏未读提示。
选择工作区使用置顶的原生目录窗口；桌面窗口与任务栏稳定显示 DSH-Portable 自有图标。
设置中可以从经过验证且与当前 Portable 兼容的版本目录选择 DeepSeek Harness 内核，并保留独立的产品更新入口。
插件市场一次安装或更新即可获取目标最新版本；已安装的默认插件随 Portable 升级到已审查基线，主动删除的插件不重装，较新版本不降级。
主界面会显示可用更新和当前隔离环境；插件市场同步了 dsh-market 1.41 中适合 Portable 的代理、搜索和分页兼容修复。
knownIssues: 内置 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.2-rc.1；Clash/Mihomo Fake-IP DNS 下 web_fetch 可能返回 WEB_BLOCKED_URL，见[上游说明](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/5202)。
Windows 下载尚未签名；macOS 使用临时签名，尚未经过 Apple 公证。首次打开方式见 README。
upgradeNotes: 已有用户可在便携版设置中手动检查产品更新；安装前结束正在运行的任务。更新保留用户数据，建议事先备份整个便携目录。

en.summary: 0.6.0 adds Windows task notifications and engine selection, with improvements to plugin updates and workspace opening.
highlights: Windows background completion and requests for answers or approval reach Action Center, with originating-task Reply, simple choices, and an unread taskbar indicator.
Workspace selection uses a topmost native folder dialog, while the desktop window and taskbar retain the DSH-Portable application icon.
Settings can select DeepSeek Harness from a verified, Portable-compatible version catalog while keeping product updates separate.

Market installs and updates obtain the intended current version in one operation. Installed defaults advance to the reviewed baseline; removed defaults stay removed and newer versions are never downgraded.
The main shell shows available updates and the active isolated environment, and the market includes the applicable proxy, search, and pager compatibility fixes from dsh-market 1.41.
knownIssues: Bundled DeepSeek Harness 0.1.2-rc.1 may return WEB_BLOCKED_URL for web_fetch under Clash/Mihomo Fake-IP DNS. See the [upstream discussion](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/5202).
Windows downloads are unsigned; macOS builds are ad-hoc signed and not notarized. See the README for first-launch instructions.
upgradeNotes: Existing users can manually check for product updates in Portable settings. Finish active tasks before installing; updates preserve user data, and backing up the entire portable folder first is recommended.
